metadata.title: Cloud Infrastructure-as-a-Service Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for securely operating consumer-managed infrastructure resources in public or private cloud environments under a shared responsibility model.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud infrastructure services including virtual machines, virtual networks, block and object storage, and provider control planes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that core cloud IaaS trust assumptions are satisfied for consumer-managed resources.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Cloud infrastructure trust assumptions depend on the underlying hosting and jurisdictional context.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Cloud IaaS security relies on trusted automation and management control planes.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Initial access via exposed cloud infrastructure interfaces or misconfigured services.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Privilege escalation through cloud role misconfiguration or excessive permissions.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Defense evasion through modification of cloud configuration or logging settings.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Lateral movement across cloud infrastructure resources and accounts.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to access cloud infrastructure resources.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Account manipulation through modification of cloud roles, policies, or identities.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Privileged access management for cloud infrastructure identities and roles.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Configuration hardening and drift prevention for cloud infrastructure resources.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Change verification and monitoring for cloud infrastructure state.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Infrastructure-as-a-Service Core defines the foundational trust properties required to safely operate consumer-managed cloud resources. This pattern explicitly models shared responsibility, cloud-native identity and configuration risks, and control-plane exposure, without prescribing provider-specific services or configurations.

components.title: IaaS Resource Isolation
components.description: Ensures separation between cloud tenants, subscriptions, projects, or accounts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cloud infrastructure boundaries prevent unauthorized access across tenants or resource groups.

components.title: Cloud Control Plane Awareness
components.description: Defines trust boundaries and risk exposure associated with provider-managed control planes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cloud consumers understand and constrain their reliance on provider control-plane behavior.

components.title: Consumer Responsibility Enforcement
components.description: Ensures that security responsibilities owned by the cloud consumer are explicitly addressed.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Consumer-managed infrastructure responsibilities are clearly defined and implemented.
